verdict.rationale: Appwrite's core database supports typed columns, relationships, and indexes (appwrite-docs-6), and it also offers a dedicated native PostgreSQL option reachable via psql/Prisma/Drizzle for full relational SQL (appwrite-docs-8, appwrite-docs-46), which would support joins/constraints/transactions. However, the evidence never shows Appwrite's own Query API (the primary product) supporting true joins, constraint enforcement, or multi-document transactions — relational queries beyond relationship auto-population appear to require dropping to the separate Postgres product. missing for 10: documentation of joins/transactions/constraints in Appwrite's native Query language, evidence of ACID transaction support, and independent confirmation of constraint enforcement.
